channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Rare total solar eclipse to darken Europe: Watch live
item.description: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will darken parts of Europe, with Spain offering prime views. ESA will livestream the event.

item.title: Podcast: The Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST)
item.description: Robert Blum of NSF Noirlab discusses the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's main project, the Legacy Survey of Space and Time, and its transformative potential.

item.title: Researchers uncover a hidden mechanism in silver nanocatalysts
item.description: Silver nanocatalysts have been observed to shift the location of their key reactions depending on the operating mode of a solid oxide cell, offering new insights into their behavior.

item.title: Potato cultivation may have endowed Andean ancestors with digestive advantages
item.description: The introduction of potatoes in the Andes appears to have influenced human genetics. Indigenous Peruvians possess unusually high numbers of a starch-digesting gene variant, likely an adaptation to a potato-rich diet.
